evals.prompt: Perform code review on a pull request that introduces an unhandled null exception bug in a user controller file.
evals.expected_output: The skill identifies the null pointer vulnerability, ranks it as BLOCKING severity with exact file:line evidence, and proposes a fix.
expectations: Ranks unhandled null exception bug as BLOCKING severity
Provides precise file path and line number reference

evals.prompt: Review a code submission that duplicates 3 lines of logging across two methods and suggests over-abstracting them with a new factory class.
evals.expected_output: The skill applies DRY/KISS principles with pragmatic judgment, advising against unnecessary factory abstraction.
expectations: Evaluates DRY/KISS principles pragmatically without over-engineering
Advises against introducing complex factory class for minor duplication
Categorizes suggestions into SHOULD-FIX or NIT buckets

evals.prompt: Run static analysis checks and perform code review on modified payment service files.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs linter and typecheck tools, categorizes findings into ranked buckets with line evidence, and remains read-only.
expectations: Executes available linter and typecheck static analysis commands
Ranks review findings into BLOCKING, SHOULD-FIX, and NIT categories
Maintains read-only review status without mutating codebase files
